Legendary Resistance (3/Day) If the jhotus fails a Saving Th row, it 
can choose to succeed instead.
Grime Soiled Hide Th e jhotus has Advantage on Saving Th rows 
against spells and other magical effects.
Th e Musk of Rot Th e jhotus can detect the scent of creatures and 
decay with its keen sense of smell at great distances, up to 1 mile 
away. It can discern the direction and approximate distance of 
the source of the scent. Additionally, it has Advantage on Wisdom 
(Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Lumbering Beast Th e jhotus ignores diffi cult terrain as well 
as move through creatures of Medium or smaller size. When it 
moves through vegetation, it leaves behind a 10 ft. wide path of 
destroyed foliage.
Natural Calamity Th e jhotus deals double damage to objects and 
structures.
Multiattack Th e jhotus makes three attacks, using Ivory Tusks, 
Fetid Bite, Hoofed Stomp in any combination.
Actions
Reaction
Legendary Actions
Ivory Tusks Melee Attack Roll: +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. 
Hit: 31 (4d10 + 9) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature 
sized Large or smaller, it is knocked back 10 ft..
Fetid Bite Melee Attack Roll: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit:
27 (4d8 + 9) Piercing damage. Constitution Saving Th row: DC 18, 
creature that the jhotus has successfully hit with its Fetid Bite 
attack. Failure: 21 (6d6) Poison damage, while poisoned, the 
creature has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Th rows for 
1 minute, the poisoned creature can repeat the Saving Th row 
at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a 
success. Success: Half damage.
Hoofed Stomp Melee Attack Roll:+15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. 
Hit: 35 (4d12 + 9) Bludgeoning damage. Strength Saving Th row: DC 
20, Large or smaller creature that the jhotus has successfully 
hit with its Hoofed Stomp attack. Failure: Target has the Prone 
condition.
Quilled Hide Trigger: A creature hits the jhotus with a melee 
attack. Response - Constitution Saving Th row: DC 16, the triggering 
creature. Failure: Th e creature takes 10 (3d6) Poison damage.
Legendary Action Uses 3 (4 in Lair) Immediately after another 
creature's turn, the jhotus can expend a Legendary Action Use to take 
one of the following actions. Th e jhotus regains all expended Legendary 
Actions at the start of each of its turns.
Gore Th e jhotus makes one Ivory Tusks attack.
Th undering Earth Th e jhotus moves up to its Speed without 
provoking Opportunity Attacks. Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 19, 
each creature within 5 ft. of the jhotus as it moves is targeted 
once by the following effect. Failure: Th e target has the Prone 
condition. 
Roar of the Weald Constitution Saving Th row: DC 22, each creature 
in a 90 ft. Cone. Failure: 9 (2d8) Th under damage, the target has the 
Frightened condition; its Speed is halved. Success: Half damage.
Defensive Instinct (1/Day) When the jhotus has reached 0 hit points.
As a Reaction, Constitution Saving Th row: DC 5 + damage taken 
from the most recent hit, the jhotus. Success: Th e jhotus drops to 1 
Hit Point instead.
Senses Blindsight 60 ft., Passive Perception 19
Challenge 20 (25,000 XP; PB 6)
Skills Athletics +15, Intimidation +7, Perception +9
Resistances Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing
Immunities Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, Poison
Fleeing Wildlife Th e inhabitants of the Wealdwoods often flee 
from the jhotus and are exceptionally skittish. Travelers within 
6 miles of the Lair have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Animal 
Handling) checks.
Scarce Hunts Many creatures steer clear of apex predator's 
hunting grounds, not wanting to contend with such a formidable 
presence. Travelers within 5 miles of the Lair must re-roll the 
fi rst of any creature results for Hunting Expeditions.
Blooming Growth Within 4 miles of the Lair, life has taken 
root from the jhotus' effect of clearing out decay. Any Foraging 
Expeditions will yield double the discovered result.
Scavenger’s Wake Within 3 miles of the Lair, the more cunning 
creatures know to take advantage of the fresh feasts that may 
lay in the remains of the jhotus' path. Double the amount of 
creatures from the results on the Scavengers Table.
Unfamiliar Paths Trees lay fallen, wide new paths break through 
the underbrush and new growth covers the old. Travelers within 
2 miles of the Lair attempting to track have Disadvantage on 
Wisdom (Survival) checks. In addition, at the Keepers discretion, 
any existing maps may become obsolete.
Tree Felling Tremors Trees lay broken and precarious in the wake 
of a wandering jhotus. At the Keepers discretion, heavy winds or 
bad luck can cause a branch to break and fall dangerously within 
1 mile of the Lair. A Traveler near a tree rolls a 2d20, any result of 
a 1 has that tree fall. Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 12, target creature. 
Failure: 11 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage and the terrain becomes 
Diffi cult terrain 10 ft. Sphere around the fallen tree.
Felling Quake Th e jhotus slams its powerful hooves into the 
ground creating a localized earthquake. Strength Saving Th row:
DC 20, each creature within a 60 ft. Emanation originating from 
the jhotus. Failure: Th e target has the Prone condition. In addition, 
at the Keepers discretion, nearby trees will fall from the unstable 
earth. A Traveler near a tree rolls a 3d20, any result of a 1 has that 
tree fall. Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 12, target creature. Failure: 11 
(2d10) Bludgeoning damage and the terrain becomes Diffi cult 
terrain 10 ft. around the fallen tree. 
Tusk Turned Earth Digging its powerful tusks deeply into the 
soil, it lifts up mounds of dirt and stone. Th e jhotus designates a 
20 ft. Square area adjacent to it. Th e terrain in that area becomes 
Diffi cult terrain.
Trunk Toss If a felled tree is within 10 ft. of the jhotus, it can use 
its powerful tusks to hurl it towards a point within 60 ft. of itself. 
Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 18, all creatures within 20 ft. Sphere of 
the hurled tree. Failure: 22 (4d10) Bludgeoning damage and the 
terrain becomes Diffi cult terrain 10 ft. around the fallen tree. 
Success: Half damage. 
Quill Barrage Shaking its rancid hide vigorously, a hail of quills 
fly off in all directions. Dexterity Saving Th row: DC 16, each creature 
within a 10 ft. Emanation originating from the jhotus. Failure: 10 
(3d6) Poison damage. Success: Half damage. 
Renewing Feast (1/Day) Th e jhotus turns its head and vigorously 
chews on whatever nearest organic matter it can get into its 
mouth. Th e jhotus regains 21 (2d20) Hit Points.
[Seasonal] Buried Decay Ripping open the earth with its tusks, 
the jhotus reveals a seam of rotten fungal spores. Th e jhotus 
designates a 10 ft. Sphere area adjacent to it. Constitution Saving 
Th row: DC 14, all creatures within the designated area. Failure: 21 
(6d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. 
On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the jhotus takes a 
lair action to cause one of the following effects, the jhotus can’t 
use the same effect two rounds in a row.
Lair Actions
Regional Effects
Th e Wealdwoods bow to the titanic presence of a jhotus, trees 
shudder and fall while all but the most conniving predators and 
prey flee from its earth shaking footfalls.
